paper_title: Evidence for light-by-light scattering and searches for axion-like particles in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions at $\sqrt{s_\mathrm{NN}} =$ 5.02 TeV
notes: CMS sets 95% CL exclusion limits on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma=1/Lambda vs ALP mass (5-90 GeV) from gamma gamma -> a -> gamma gamma in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions. This is a collider/UPC bound, not a DM haloscope, so no DM density. The coupling type is AxionPhoton. However, the numerical g_agamma vs m_a exclusion contour is only shown in Fig. 7 (not as a table), and no explicit numerical values are extractable from the provided text. Cross section limits in 1500-20 nb range over 5-90 GeV are mentioned but g_agamma values are not tabulated.
